LESSON: HUMAN CIRCULATORY SYSTEM

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Living Things and the Environment
Topic 1.3: Human circulatory system

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Human circulatory system. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Human circulatory system
2. Practise Human circulatory system at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Human circulatory system

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Human circulatory system
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Human circulatory system. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Human circulatory system at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Human circulatory system at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Human circulatory system
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Human circulatory system. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Human circulatory system using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Human circulatory system in the examples.
2. Explain Human circulatory system to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Human circulatory system.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Human circulatory system using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Human circulatory system important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Human circulatory system
2. Practise Human circulatory system at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Human circulatory system

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
